hero_subhead: Attract and retain your best team with culture, mentorship, and health and wellness opportunities for a small fraction of the cost. Den 1880 is a premium space paid by the seat, not by the square foot. We are located in the core of Uptown Waterloo near the LRT and countless restaurants. It includes coworking spaces, a full high-end fitness facility, The Vault podcast studio, a boutique event venue, and more, all on one simple corporate plan. Provide your team with a world-class offer most companies can't afford to make.
